Pattern:
(?:(?<=\\(\\?\\<)(?<groupname>\\w+?)(?=\\>\\)))
Explanation:
○ Zero-width positive lookbehind.
○ Match the string "(?<" right-to-left.
○ "groupname" capture group.
○ Match a word character atomically at least once.
○ Zero-width positive lookahead.
○ Match the string ">)".

○ Match a character in the set [^{}] atomically any number of times.

○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.

member.name: P:Parser.RX.TokenTemplateDefinition
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^(?'ref_name'\\w+)\\s*\\-\\s*(?'line''(?'literal'.+?)'|(?'ws_req'\\ )|(?'opt_ws_or_comment'\\-)|\\#(?'ref'\\w+)|(?'gp_start'\\()|(?'gp_end'\\))|(?'opt'\\?)|(?'more'\\+)|(?'or'\\|))*$\\s*
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ "ref_name" capture group.
○ Match a word character atomically at least once.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match '-'.
○ Match a whitespace character greedily any number of times.
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ "line" capture group.
○ Match with 9 alternative expressions.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match '\''.
○ "literal" capture group.
○ Match a character other than '\n' lazily at least once.
○ Match '\''.
○ "ws_req" capture group.
○ Match ' '.
○ "opt_ws_or_comment" capture group.
○ Match '-'.
